purpose: Operational evidence-sufficiency routing; not correctness calibration.
scope: Only fields used by configured submission rules affect automatic verification.
rationale: The 0.90 operational floor is below the mentor OCR field-confidence p10 (approximately 0.934) and routes observed low outliers without claiming a probability of correctness.
limitations: The mentor dataset is controlled and synthetic.
No complete field-level answer key exists.
The threshold is not statistically calibrated to correctness.
Additional real-world layouts may require policy revision.
